text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki~! When I bought your birthday 
present at the stationery store, they gave 
me a raffle ticket!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
First prize is... believe it or not! A 
pair trip to France!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When you think of France, it's the capital 
of art...! Manga exhibitions have been 
held there too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
International exchange through manga...! 
And speaking of soulful connections, that 
race simply cannot be left out!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"! Buu 
absolutely, definitely wants to go too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right?! We even told the manga fans we met 
there, 'We're actually planning to run at 
that racecourse over there'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Turning that run seen by so many witnesses 
into a manga... and having it displayed in 
an exhibition or something...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, Kiseki's gonna be a total 
local celebrityyy!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wanna go hit the lottery right 
now? It might actually come true, you 
know!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because today is... Kiseki's birthday! 
Luck might just be on our side!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Become the "protagonist," Kiseki! The 
story starts right here~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Manga protagonists always 
have "luck on their side" at times like 
this. ...Right?!
